_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N351865 (2025-08-22, dev split): CBP held United Kingdom. Product written by the agent from the facts, no model draft (D823). Target China (reverse probe: away from a non-China origin); plant capabilities for China and all costs are assumptions. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: Ultra-low differential pressure sensor (MEMS), 0-5 mbar
product.description: A piezoresistive silicon pressure sensor die with signal-processing circuitry, wire bonded and encapsulated in a moulded plastic package, for HVAC units.

components.name: Plastic moulding compound and lead frame

operations.name: Make the sensor die: photolithography, ion implantation, sputtering, wet and dry etching and probe inspection
Wire bond and encapsulate the die, run continuity and function tests and pack
